spec2def(jsproxy.dll jsproxy.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# jsproxy.dll is all Rust (jsproxy-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/jsproxy-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/jsproxy-rust/src/jsproxy/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(jsproxy jsproxy-cargo jsproxy.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE jsproxy-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk uuid_sources)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
